judged_text: The embeddable_hosts table has no UNIQUE constraint or index on host, so duplicate hosts are representable and the hot-path lookup `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` runs unindexed and non-sargable (function-wrapped column). Admins can save the same host twice and get two rows with different category_ids where `record_for_host(...).first` silently picks one by unspecified order; the per-request embed/comments lookup does a sequential scan of a function-wrapped column.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `embeddable_hosts` (migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts`) without any index or UNIQUE constraint on `host`, and the model has no `validates_uniqueness_of :host`. Yet hot-path lookups use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` with `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, which (a) permits duplicate rows and then picks an arbitrary row via `.first` (order not specified), and (b) wraps the column in `lower(...)`, preventing a normal btree index on `host` from being used even if later added. These are concrete, diff-grounded data-integrity/performance concerns, though they aren’t an immediately failing behavior in the PR as-is.
